Tests shredder counts, chained Merkle shreds, skip logic, and performance.

# Purpose
This file is a test and performance driver for the `fd_shredder` code. It creates shredder instances, feeds them entry batches, and checks that the shredder produces the expected number of data shreds, parity shreds, and FEC sets for different shred types, including `FD_SHRED_TYPE_MERKLE_DATA`, `FD_SHRED_TYPE_MERKLE_DATA_CHAINED`, and `FD_SHRED_TYPE_MERKLE_DATA_CHAINED_RESIGNED`. It also verifies batch skipping, slot and index handling, chained Merkle root updates, and shred parsing. The [`main`](<#main>) function runs all tests and ends with a `pass` log message when the checks succeed.

The file also contains performance tests that measure shred generation throughput for large entry batches. In hosted builds, it includes a PCAP-based validation test that compares generated shreds against recorded fixture data from `demo-shreds.pcap` and `demo-shreds.bin`. The code uses a local signer context with `fd_ed25519_sign`, imports a test private key fixture, and allocates fixed buffers for shred output and test data.
